title: Kepler Quadrant Calibration Observation
description: Canonical raw row format for quadrant calibration observations.

target_id.description: Stable identifier or recorded label for the calibration target intentionally measured by the observer.

target_vertical_offset_m.description: Signed vertical displacement of the calibration target relative to the observer's eye-level reference, in meters. Positive values are above eye level.

angle_deg.description: Raw quadrant angle reading in degrees.
